description: Horaires des lignes du réseau GPSO Zenbus au format GTFS is a dataset listed in GPSO - Grand Paris Seine Ouest - OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Seine Ouest - ZenBus. Horaires au format GTFS du réseau GPSO Zenbus du Territoire de Grand Paris Seine Ouest. 7 Lignes locales: SUBB à Boulogne-Billancourt Chavilbus à Chaville TUVIM à Issy-les-Moulineaux TIM à Meudon Navette à Vanves Ligne 526 à Ville-d'Avray, Sèvres et Marnes-la-Coquette Ligne 469 à Sèvres, Chaville et Ville-d'Avray. Coverage: Grand Paris Seine Ouest. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Mobilité. Its keywords are GTFS, Chavilbus, SUBB, TUVIM, TIM, Ligne 526. The portal shows 10 records. The portal shows 2026-07-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-seineouest-fr-portal.
